0022600099.text: The Bucks, who are 0-1 and sit 4th in the Central, 1 game back, and 13th in the East, host the Bulls, also 0-1 and 5th in the Central, 1 game back, in the second game of the season for both teams. This season's series is yet to start, while the Bucks won the 2025-26 series 3-1, and their most recent meeting was a 120-97 loss in Chicago on March 1, 2026. Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain and Jordan Hawkins, who are out with illness, and Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury.
